subject.title: Add optional `name`/`label` field to group config entries

question: Which single public metadata field, if any, should OpenClaw accept on group/channel config entries, and should it apply to all group-capable channels in the core config contract?
rationale: The code change is mechanically clear, but the permanent config contract name and cross-channel scope are product/API decisions that should not be chosen by cleanup automation.

options.title: Adopt `name` consistently
options.body: Add one optional string `name` field across relevant group-entry schemas, types, generated metadata, docs, and tests while keeping runtime behavior unchanged.

options.title: Use a different canonical field
options.body: Choose `label` or `description` instead, then implement only that one field everywhere to avoid aliases and drift.

options.title: Defer descriptive metadata
options.body: Keep strict behavior-only group entries for now and rely on external config comments/docs rather than expanding the public config surface.

recommendation.title: Adopt `name` consistently
recommendation.body: Add one optional string `name` field across relevant group-entry schemas, types, generated metadata, docs, and tests while keeping runtime behavior unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is tied to the strict config contract history and already reviewed this exact issue as a config-contract decision.
